description: This file contains an integration test for sessions_yield behavior in the embedded Pi session management, using vitest testing framework. It tests scenarios where sessions yield, have pending tool calls, or are idle after yielding.

methods.name: loadRunOverflowCompactionHarness
methods.description: Loads the test harness for overflow compaction scenarios, initializing the embedded Pi agent.

methods.name: mockedRunEmbeddedAttempt
methods.description: Mocked function simulating the result of embedded attempt runs.

methods.name: makeAttemptResult
methods.description: Creates a mock result object for embedded attempt calls, with options for yield detection and session ID.

methods.name: isEmbeddedPiRunActive
methods.description: Checks if a given embedded Pi session is currently active.

methods.name: queueEmbeddedPiMessage
methods.description: Attempts to enqueue a message to a session; returns false if it cannot be delivered directly.
